umbra-4row.notes: Fixes keys that could get stuck: switching into Gamepad mode while holding a key, changing a stick key while holding it, and turning XInput off mid-game. The stick no longer repeats a key when the deadzone is set high.

umbra-3row.notes: Fixes keys that could get stuck: switching into Gamepad mode while holding a key, changing a stick key while holding it, and turning XInput off mid-game. The stick no longer repeats a key when the deadzone is set high.

penumbra-4row.notes: Fixes keys that could get stuck: switching into Gamepad mode while holding a key, remapping a held key, and turning XInput off mid-game.

penumbra-3row.notes: Fixes keys that could get stuck: switching into Gamepad mode while holding a key, remapping a held key, and turning XInput off mid-game.
